sourceNotes: Game incarnation Emissary from Predator: Hunting Grounds, released April19 2022. Distinct from the two cut-film Emissary designs of The Predator.
Body equipment extrapolates the partly occluded lower legs/back from official key art. Artistic reconstruction, no certified1:1 claim.
Only idle has six authored frames in each direction. Movement, attacks and round performances remain incomplete and use an explicitly declared native stance.
No invented exclusive canonical location: existing Hunting Grounds shared location association remains unchanged.
